limits: Frozen source commit, not concurrent working-tree edits. No production Java or JVM configuration changed.

Real scheduler, state and Master Netty gRPC, loopback synthetic workload; no GPU inference. BATCH uses 750 mock Prefill gRPC servers; Decode workers are logical endpoints. NON_BATCH does not run frontend fetch or actual worker delivery.
Synthetic terminal events release resources after successful callbacks; test is not a preemption-heavy benchmark or proof for all concurrency interleavings.
Harness retains full wire payloads/received batches/responses to validate correctness. Increasing QPS also increases retained fixture data; allocation pressure includes client/mock/test code.
Only BATCH 10K has two repetitions per profile; higher rates and NON_BATCH have one. Each warmup and measurement is ten seconds. Tail latency varies; these are not steady-state production guarantees.
Failed BATCH 40K cases abort during warmup and have no valid formal P99. They are failures, not zero-latency results.
Whole-VM allocation stalls are separate from formal measurement stalls. Process CPU and faults include client, master, mocks and GC; CPU is not GC-only.
Startup is JVM initialization via java -version, not service readiness. RSS does not account for all physical backing memory, especially ZGC shared mappings.
THP settings and OS are recorded, unchanged. Collector memory mapping/page behavior may differ. Fault/latency correlations do not alone establish causality.
New factorial uses a fixed small Maven launcher rather than prior global JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS; compare within this matrix rather than attributing prior absolute differences solely to GC.
runner_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/flexlb-jdk21-20261002
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export MAVEN_OPTS="-Xms512m -Xmx2g -Duser.home=/data0/luoli.hn/data0 -Dmaven.repo.local=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/.m2/repository"
unset JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS _JAVA_OPTIONS || true
root=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-gc-factorial-20261009
cd "$root"
tar -xf source.tar
sha256sum source.tar > archive.sha256
find rtp_llm/flexlb rtp_llm/cpp/model_rpc/proto -type f -not -path '*/target/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > source-manifest.sha256
mkdir -p evidence
{ cat revision.txt; java -version; uname -a; getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || true; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/shmem_enabled; free -h; } > evidence/environment.txt 2>&1
flags_for() {
 case "$1" in
  g1) flags='-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch';;
  g1_pretouch) flags='-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch';;
  zgc) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch';;
  zgc_pretouch) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch';;
 esac
}
for profile in g1 zgc_pretouch g1_pretouch zgc; do
 flags_for "$profile"
 for repeat in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "evidence/startup/$profile"
  python3 "$root/startup.py" "evidence/startup/$profile/$repeat" \
   java -Xms64g -Xmx64g $flags -XX:+PrintFlagsFinal -version
 done
 done
cd rtp_llm/flexlb
run_case() {
 profile="$1"; mode="$2"; qps="$3"; repeat="$4"
 flags_for "$profile"
 out="$root/evidence/$profile/$mode-$qps-r$repeat"
 mkdir -p "$out"
 printf '%s\n' "$flags" > "$out/flags.txt"
 decision=FIXED_WINDOW
 if [[ "$mode" == NON_BATCH ]]; then decision=SINGLE; fi
 python3 "$root/monitor.py" "$root" "$out/process.jsonl" "$out/monitor.stop" &
 monitor_pid=$!
 echo "START $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat $(date -Is)"
 code=0
 ./mvnw -B -P 'opensource,!internal,api-performance-regression' -pl flexlb-api -am \
  '-Dtest=MasterBatchEndToEndPerformanceTest#masterMeetsRateSloAcrossEngineScaleMatrix' \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dflexlb.perf.heap=64g \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.jvm-args=$flags -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=$out/gc-%p.log:time,uptime,level,tags" \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.delivery-mode=$mode" "-Dflexlb.perf.decision-mode=$decision" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-topologies=750x750 \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-target-qps=$qps" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-duration-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-requests-per-prefill=16 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-min-qps-ratio=0.98 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-server-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-client-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-batch-wait-p99-ms=50 \
  test > "$out/test.log" 2>&1 || code=$?
 touch "$out/monitor.stop"
 wait "$monitor_pid"
 printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out/test.exit"
 awk '/FlexLB Master engine-scale E2E:|FlexLB Master traffic failure:|\[ERROR\]   Master|OutOfMemoryError|BUILD SUCCESS|BUILD FAILURE/' "$out/test.log"
 echo "END $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat exit=$code $(date -Is)"
}
for qps in 10000 20000 40000; do
 for mode in BATCH NON_BATCH; do
  if [[ "$qps" == 20000 ]]; then profiles='zgc g1_pretouch zgc_pretouch g1'; else profiles='g1 zgc_pretouch g1_pretouch zgc'; fi
  for profile in $profiles; do run_case "$profile" "$mode" "$qps" 1; done
 done
 done
for profile in zgc g1_pretouch zgc_pretouch g1; do run_case "$profile" BATCH 10000 2; done
cd "$root"
sha256sum --quiet -c source-manifest.sha256
printf 'done\n' > matrix.done
startup_script:
import json,resource,subprocess,sys,time
path=sys.argv[1];start=time.perf_counter()
with open(path+'.flags','w') as f:
 p=subprocess.run(sys.argv[2:],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
with open(path+'.json','w') as f:
 json.dump({'elapsed_s':time.perf_counter()-start,'user_s':r.ru_utime,'system_s':r.ru_stime,'max_rss_kb':r.ru_maxrss,'minor_faults':r.ru_minflt,'major_faults':r.ru_majflt,'exit':p.returncode},f)
sys.exit(p.returncode)
